definitions.explanation: A statement about what will happen in the future, typically based on analysis or data.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}を{予測|よそく}するのは{難|むずか}しい。
{専門家|せんもんか}の{予測|よそく}によると、{経済|けいざい}は{回復|かいふく}する。
examples.english: According to experts' forecasts, the economy will recover.

examples.notes: 予測が当たる = prediction proves correct

notes:
USAGE: {予測|よそく} is often used in technical, scientific, or analytical contexts. It implies a more systematic or data-based prediction compared to {予想|よそう}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{予測|よそく}する (to predict, forecast)
・{予測|よそく}が{当|あ}たる (prediction proves correct)
・{予測|よそく}が{外|はず}れる (prediction proves wrong)
・{予測|よそく}{不能|ふのう} (unpredictable)

CONTRAST:
・{予想|よそう} - expectation (general, informal)
・{予測|よそく} - prediction (analytical, technical)
